How head control works
  1. A helper can enable the camera and start setup.
  2. Follow five short prompts using only comfortable movements.
  3. Move your head to guide the pointer. Hold over a message to select it.
  4. Move to Confirm or Cancel, then hold again.

If you move your chair or camera, set your movement range again.

Your camera stays private.

Images are processed on this device. No video upload or recording.

Make it comfortable

Use movements that feel comfortable. A helper can adjust these controls.

Small movements are filtered to help you hold a message. Lower sensitivity slows movement; Strong smoothing makes the pointer steadier. If tracking stops, selection stops too. Escape cancels a draft message. Space pauses active head control when you’re not editing text.
